uhid.description: Unique Universal Health Identifier issued at registration
uhid.prompt_when_missing: Please enter the patient's 6-digit UHID (e.g. SMCH-102934).

insurance_type.description: Category of payment or empanelled insurance scheme
insurance_type.prompt_when_missing: Please specify the payment/insurance category (PM-JAY, CMCHIS, Private TPA, or Self-Paying).

policy_or_pmjay_id.description: Golden Card number or Insurance Policy Number
policy_or_pmjay_id.prompt_when_missing: Please provide the active policy number or PM-JAY Golden Card ID.

consent_form_signed.description: Verification that Form A-1 general admission consent is physically or digitally signed
consent_form_signed.prompt_when_missing: Has the patient or legal guardian signed the General Admission Consent Form? (Yes/No)

attendant_contact.description: Primary emergency contact number of the patient's attendant
attendant_contact.prompt_when_missing: Please provide a valid 10-digit emergency contact phone number for the attendant.

ward_name.description: Target ward destination in SMCH (e.g. Ward 3A, Ward 4A, MICU)
ward_name.prompt_when_missing: Please choose the designated ward location for the patient.

bed_no.description: Specific bed identifier within the ward
bed_no.prompt_when_missing: Please provide the allocated bed number (e.g. B-04).

test_or_modality_code.description: Diagnostic test identifier or imaging modality (e.g. CBC, Troponin-I, CT-Brain)
test_or_modality_code.prompt_when_missing: Please specify the exact diagnostic test or imaging investigation requested.

urgency_level.prompt_when_missing: Is this order STAT (immediate) or ROUTINE?

allergy_check_passed.description: Pharmacist validation that patient has no known contraindications or drug allergies
allergy_check_passed.prompt_when_missing: Please confirm that patient allergy cross-check has been performed and passed.

preauth_approval_code.description: TMS Portal or TPA Insurance Pre-Authorization Approval Code
preauth_approval_code.prompt_when_missing: Please enter the pre-authorization approval code issued by the insurer.

approved_sum_inr.description: Financial sum sanctioned by the insurer in INR
approved_sum_inr.prompt_when_missing: Please specify the total sanctioned pre-authorization amount in INR.

physician_clearance_signoff.description: Treating consultant doctor's formal signature granting medical discharge
physician_clearance_signoff.prompt_when_missing: Doctor sign-off required: Has the primary consultant signed the clinical discharge order?

vitals_stability_confirmed.description: Nursing verification of hemodynamically stable vitals prior to room release
vitals_stability_confirmed.prompt_when_missing: Nursing check required: Are patient vitals confirmed stable for discharge?
